name: wasm32
title: WebAssembly (wasm32)
description: P175: LambLisp as a WebAssembly module.  Two hosts share this platform: wasm32-wasip1 via wasi-sdk (a CLI module for wasmtime/wasmer/node), and wasm32-emscripten via emcc (a browser page).  WASM IS A BUILD TARGET, NOT AN NCG BACKEND -- the AST and bytecode tiers are the runtime and the host engine supplies the native speed.
